data.long_meaning: One who gathers or takes. A collector or gatherer. The name Laaiq carries the meaning “Taking, Gathering” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Laaiq usually hope their child will grow to embody taking, gathering and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laaiq total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
